name: Gale
self_text: Gale, late 30s, Korean, prefers to keep gender private. I studied economics, now diving into statistics. I love swing dancing – the rhythm keeps me alive and the social energy lifts my mood. I work best with a step‑by‑step walkthrough session, and I enjoy occasional short exchanges to keep things lively. When it comes to tutoring, I’m happy to explain things clearly. I can meet in person or online, whichever is convenient. My free slots are Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning, or Sunday morning. If you’re looking for a patient guide who breaks concepts down one step at a time, let’s connect. I’ll bring the same enthusiasm I have for dancing to our sessions, making learning feel like a dance.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with complete silence while working or occasional short exchanges, you need to be the one who has things explained by me, you must be into a step-by-step walkthrough session, and you must be available any of Saturday afternoon or Saturday morning or Sunday morning; nice if you are into statistics.
